product_overview: FilmyConnect is a social networking backend for film industry professionals to register, build profiles, post content, follow each other, and communicate through communities and direct messages. It also supports media upload validation, notifications, wallet payments, and moderation workflows for a mobile app and admin panel.
core_goals: Support secure member authentication with password and OTP login, token refresh, and password management
Enable member profile management, public discovery, and safe account deletion with cascading cleanup
Provide post creation, donation-post handling, personalized feeds, and engagement actions such as likes and comments
Support follow relationships, community membership, chat-group access, and direct messaging
Power media uploads, notifications, wallet deposits, profile boosts, and moderation actions with proper validation and authorization

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Allows visitors and members to register, log in with password or OTP, refresh access tokens, change passwords, and check availability of account identifiers.
user_flows: POST /auth/register with valid name, username, email, phone, password, roles, and industries -> Receive 201 with accessToken, refreshToken, and user object -> Use Authorization: Bearer <token> on protected endpoints
POST /auth/register with an email, username, or phone already in use -> Receive 409 conflict indicating the identifier is already registered
POST /auth/login-password with valid phone and password -> Receive 200 with accessToken and user object -> Access protected endpoints using Authorization: Bearer <token>
POST /auth/login-password with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 invalid credentials
POST /auth/send-otp with a valid phone number -> Receive 200 OTP sent -> POST /auth/verify-otp with the phone and valid OTP -> Receive 200 with accessToken
POST /auth/verify-otp with an expired or incorrect OTP -> Receive 401 invalid or expired OTP
POST /auth/refresh with a valid refreshToken -> Receive 200 with a new accessToken
POST /auth/refresh with an invalid refreshToken -> Receive 401 invalid refresh token
POST /auth/change-password with Authorization: Bearer <token> and the correct currentPassword plus newPassword -> Receive 200 password changed
POST /auth/change-password with Authorization: Bearer <token> and an incorrect currentPassword -> Receive 401 current password incorrect
POST /auth/check-availability with email, username, or phone -> Receive 200 with available true or false

features.name: User Profile
features.description: Lets signed-in members view and update their own profile, search other users, view public profiles, inspect saved posts, and permanently delete their account.
user_flows: GET /users/me with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with the signed-in user's full profile -> PUT /users/me with allowed fields such as name, bio, language, roles, and industries -> Receive 200 with the updated user object
PUT /users/me with privileged fields such as walletBalance, isVerified, or role -> Receive 200 with those privileged fields ignored in the returned profile
GET /users/{id} with Authorization: Bearer <token> and a valid user id -> Receive 200 with the public profile
GET /users/{id} with an invalid identifier -> Receive 400 invalid id
GET /users with Authorization: Bearer <token> and query parameters such as q, roles, and industries -> Receive 200 with matching users excluding blocked accounts
GET /users/me/saved with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with the signed-in user's saved posts

DELETE /users/me with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 success -> Subsequent POST /auth/login-password or POST /auth/verify-otp for the deleted account is refused because the account no longer exists
GET /users/me with no Authorization header -> Receive 401 unauthorized

features.name: Posts
features.description: Allows members to create posts, fetch single posts, remove their own posts, save posts, and browse crowd-funding donation posts.
user_flows: POST /posts with Authorization: Bearer <token> and a valid body containing type, caption, isDonation, roles, and industries -> Receive 201 with the created Post -> GET /posts/{id} to retrieve the post and its engagement counters
POST /posts with invalid or incomplete post data -> Receive 400 validation error
DELETE /posts/{id} with Authorization: Bearer <token> by the post author -> Receive 200 Deleted
DELETE /posts/{id} with Authorization: Bearer <token> by a non-author -> Receive 403 post not found or unauthorized
GET /posts/donations with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with crowd-funding posts, including the requesting user's own donation posts
POST /posts/{postId}/save with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 success and toggle the saved state for that post

features.name: Feed
features.description: Provides personalized, trending, industry-filtered, and user-author feeds while excluding crowd-funding posts from all feed views.
user_flows: GET /api/feed with Authorization: Bearer <token> and optional page and limit query values -> Receive 200 with a paginated personalized Post list
GET /api/feed/trending with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with posts ranked by engagement score
GET /api/feed/industry/{industry} with Authorization: Bearer <token> and a valid industry value -> Receive 200 with posts filtered to that industry
GET /api/feed/users/{id}/posts with Authorization: Bearer <token> and a valid user id -> Receive 200 with posts authored by that user
GET /api/feed with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with feed results that exclude crowd-funding posts even when they were authored by the requesting member

features.name: Engagement
features.description: Supports likes, unlikes, comments, comment deletion, and listing engagement data on posts with counter updates and permission checks.
user_flows: POST /api/posts/{id}/like with Authorization: Bearer <token> on an existing post -> Receive 200 with updated likesCount -> DELETE /api/posts/{id}/like to unlike -> Receive 200 with likesCount decremented
POST /api/posts/{id}/like twice with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 on the first request and a rejection on the second request because likes must not double-count
POST /api/posts/{id}/comments with Authorization: Bearer <token> and valid content -> Receive 201 with the created Comment -> GET /api/posts/{id}/comments -> Receive 200 with the comment list
POST /api/posts/{id}/comments with invalid content payload -> Receive 400 validation error
DELETE /api/comments/{id} with Authorization: Bearer <token> by the comment author or post owner -> Receive 200 Deleted
DELETE /api/comments/{id} with Authorization: Bearer <token> by an unrelated member -> Receive 403 insufficient permissions
GET /api/posts/{id}/likes with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with the list of users who liked the post

features.name: Follow Graph
features.description: Lets members follow and unfollow each other, and inspect follower and following lists with validation against invalid relationships.
user_flows: POST /api/users/{id}/follow with Authorization: Bearer <token> and a valid other user id -> Receive 200 success -> GET /api/users/{id}/followers to confirm the new follower list
DELETE /api/users/{id}/follow with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 success -> GET /api/users/{id}/following to confirm the unfollowed user is removed
POST /api/users/{id}/follow with Authorization: Bearer <token> using the signed-in user's own id -> Receive 400 cannot follow yourself
GET /api/users/{id}/followers with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with the user's followers
GET /api/users/{id}/following with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with the user's following list

features.name: Communities
features.description: Supports community creation, discovery, membership listing, joining public or private communities, group access, and admin or owner moderation actions.
user_flows: POST /api/communities with Authorization: Bearer <token> and valid name, description, type, and privacy -> Receive 201 with the created Community and the creator as owner
GET /api/communities with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with discoverable communities
POST /api/communities/{id}/join with Authorization: Bearer <token> on a public community -> Receive 200 success
POST /api/communities/{id}/join with Authorization: Bearer <token> on a private community -> Receive 200 success and a join request is created for review
GET /api/communities/my with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with the communities the member has joined
GET /api/communities/{id}/members with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with the member list
DELETE /api/communities/{id} with Authorization: Bearer <token> by the owner -> Receive 200 success
DELETE /api/communities/{id} with Authorization: Bearer <token> by a non-owner -> Receive 403 only the owner can delete this community
DELETE /api/communities/{id}/members/{userId} with Authorization: Bearer <token> by a non-admin -> Receive 403 only admins can remove members
POST /api/communities/{communityId}/groups/{groupId}/join with Authorization: Bearer <token> as a non-member -> Receive 403 you must be a community member to join groups
GET /api/communities/{communityId}/groups with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with the community's chat groups

features.name: Messaging
features.description: Enables direct one-to-one messaging, conversation listing, thread retrieval, and unread counts for signed-in members.
user_flows: POST /messages with Authorization: Bearer <token> and valid recipientId, content, and type -> Receive 201 with the created Message -> GET /messages to list conversations
GET /messages/{userId} with Authorization: Bearer <token> and a valid user id -> Receive 200 with the message thread between the two users
GET /messages/unread-count with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with the unread message count
POST /messages with missing recipientId or content -> Receive 400 recipientId and content are required
GET /messages/{userId} with an invalid identifier -> Receive 400 invalid id

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Lists in-app notifications, returns unread counts, supports marking notifications read, and allows Expo push token registration.
user_flows: GET /notifications with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with the user's notifications
GET /notifications/count with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with the unread notification count
POST /notifications/read-all with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 success and all notifications become read
POST /notifications/register-token with Authorization: Bearer <token> and a valid Expo token -> Receive 200 success
POST /notifications/register-token with Authorization: Bearer <token> and an invalid Expo token -> Receive 400 invalid Expo push token

features.name: Media
features.description: Provides server-signed Cloudinary upload payloads and validates media URLs before they are used in posts or other content.
user_flows: POST /media/signature with Authorization: Bearer <token> and a supported media type -> Receive 200 with signature and timestamp for Cloudinary upload
POST /media/signature with Authorization: Bearer <token> and an invalid media type -> Receive 400 invalid media type
POST /media/validate with Authorization: Bearer <token> and a valid url plus type -> Receive 200 success after server-side media validation
POST /media/validate with Authorization: Bearer <token> and missing url or invalid type/format -> Receive 400 with an appropriate validation error

features.name: Wallet and Payments
features.description: Lets members view wallet balance, create Razorpay deposit orders, and purchase profile boost plans.
user_flows: GET /wallet/balance with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with the current wallet balance
POST /wallet/deposit/create with Authorization: Bearer <token> and a valid amount -> Receive 200 with a Razorpay orderId
POST /wallet/deposit/create with Authorization: Bearer <token> and an invalid amount -> Receive 400 invalid amount
POST /users/boost with Authorization: Bearer <token> and a valid planId -> Receive 200 success
POST /users/boost with Authorization: Bearer <token> and an invalid planId -> Receive 400 invalid boost plan selected

features.name: Moderation
features.description: Supports blocking, unblocking, and listing blocked users so members can control who can interact with or discover them.
user_flows: POST /block with Authorization: Bearer <token> and a target userId -> Receive 200 success
POST /unblock with Authorization: Bearer <token> and the same userId -> Receive 200 success
GET /users/me/blocked with Authorization: Bearer <token> -> Receive 200 with the blocked users list
POST /block with Authorization: Bearer <token> and an invalid or missing userId -> Receive a client error indicating the request is malformed

known_limitations.issue: Logout is client-side only; the refresh token is not revoked server-side
known_limitations.impact: A stolen refresh token keeps working after the user signs out

known_limitations.issue: Account deletion cascades across many collections without a transaction
known_limitations.impact: A mid-cascade failure on standalone MongoDB can leave orphaned records

known_limitations.issue: Wallet withdrawal endpoint is routed but not implemented
Rate limiting is not applied to authentication endpoints
known_limitations.impact: Login and OTP endpoints can be brute-forced
